subject: BYO KMS: chaos-drill prep & subnet isolation validation (EdgeBank private deployment)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Morgan <amorgan@edgebank.com>, ops+security@edgebank.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYO KMS: chaos-drill prep & subnet isolation validation (EdgeBank private deployment)

Hi Alice / EdgeBank SecOps,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to run a short, scoped chaos drill to validate the BYO-KMS failover and network isolation for your private deployment (VPC + on-prem bridging). Goal is to prove:

- KMS key access revocation/recovery across the bridge without customer-data loss
- Egress controls prevent accidental outbound key material exposure
- Operator/agent isolation when the on-prem HSM is temporarily unavailable

Attached is a first-draft "BYO-KMS chaos plan" (BYO-KMS-chaos-plan-v1.pdf) and the VPC/subnet diagram (vpc-subnet-map-edgebank-20250617.png). High-level ask: please confirm the two CIDR ranges we will use for the test (the redlined subnets on the map) and provide any maintenance windows.

Proposed timeline:
- June 24: dry run in staging (Redwood + KeyVault Inc. test key)
- June 25: production-impact drill (read-only for 1 hour; fallback immediately available)

Technical notes / questions for EdgeBank:
1) Do you have a pre-approved egress allowlist for the Redwood collector IPs? If not, we will limit egress to KeyVault Inc. endpoints and your management bastion only.
2) Confirm whether HSM operator accounts are allowed to access management plane from the on-prem subnet during the drill (we recommend they be disabled temporarily).
3) Which KMS key rotation window should we avoid (KMS rotates at 03:00 local on Tue — avoid conflict).

Please reply with approvals or any redlines by EOD Fri (June 20). If this sounds good I will loop in KeyVault Inc. to schedule the integration test.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BYO-KMS-chaos-plan-v1.pdf (doc), vpc-subnet-map-edgebank-20250617.png (image), kv-integration-snippet.yaml (text)

From: Alice Morgan <amorgan@edgebank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>
Cc: ops+security@edgebank.com, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYO KMS: chaos-drill prep & subnet isolation validation (EdgeBank private deployment)

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. Quick answers inline and a few clarifications.

- CIDRs: confirmed. We'll use 10.8.32.0/24 (on-prem bridge) and 10.20.10.0/24 (Redwood-managed VPC test segment).
- Egress: ops+security will only allowlist outbound to KeyVault Inc. (kv.prod.edgebank.net) + our bastion during the drill. No other outbound is permitted.
- HSM operator accounts: agreed to disable remote operator access for the 1-hour window; local console access remains.
- Rotation window: our production rotation runs 03:00 UTC on Tuesdays — we are good to avoid that.

We attached our internal network config (vpc-edgeset-20250617.json) and a short firewall snapshot. Also: we need Redwood to confirm the exact IPs you'll use for the collector and the ephemeral key-wrapping proxy. Can KeyVault Inc. provide a failover IP range for their service?

We approve the June 25 brief window for the production drill, pending final IPs and the DocuSign addendum (procurement asked for a short SOW addendum).

Best,
Alice Morgan
Senior Cloud Security Engineer
EdgeBank

--

Subject: Re: BYO KMS: chaos-drill prep & subnet isolation validation (EdgeBank private deployment)

Thanks Alice — appreciate the quick confirmations. A few technical clarifications and our preflight checklist items:

Preflight checklist (what Redwood will validate in staging on June 24):
- Confirm ephemeral key-wrapping proxy only accepts TLS connections from 10.20.10.0/24 and 10.8.32.0/24.
- Validate that KV integration snippet (kv-integration-snippet.yaml) can fall back to a wrapped-key cache for up to 15 minutes if the on-prem HSM becomes unreachable.
- Test audit-log continuity: our agent will buffer audit events locally and forward to your SIEM via the bastion when connectivity is restored — confirm buffering limits.
- Simulate operator lockout: we will toggle operator access and verify operator actions are rejected by the control plane.

Network/ACL specifics we need from EdgeBank (please provide as small diffs):
- Exact port list for internal HSM management (usually 16992/16993 management, but some vendors differ).
- Any NAT rules that could rewrite source IPs for outbound to kv.prod.edgebank.net (makes allowlist harder).

KeyVault Inc. — can you confirm your failover endpoints and whether your service supports a pre-signed wrap token (short-lived) that Redwood can present to fetch transient wrapping keys? If not, we will rely on wrapped-key cache behavior.

Action items (owners):
- Soojin: finalize staging checklist and run preflight (June 24)
- KeyVault Inc.: provide failover IPs + wrap-token support note (Due: Jun 20)
- EdgeBank ops: provide NAT/firewall diffs and DocuSign contact (Due: Jun 20)
- Marcus: coordinate SOW addendum and schedule

I'll post the staging checklist to the shared Drive link and paste the checklist here after internal review.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
